senses.gloss: (cmp. צַד) to lie in wait, aim; to hunt, capture. Part. צוֹדֶה (= אוֹרֵב) ambush.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 1:9">R. Hash. I, 9</cite> <he>אם צ׳ להם</he> if an ambush (of Samaritans) is apprehended.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 787:24">Yalk. Num. 787</cite>, v. infra.

<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 160:6">Sifré Num. 160</cite> (expl. <cite ref="R00110"><he>צְדִיָּה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Numbers 35:20">Num. XXXV, 20</cite>) <he>שצ׳ לו שמתכוון לו</he> he aimed at him, had the intention of killing just him; Yalk. l. c. <he>שצוֹדֶה</he>.
